project_type: React 18 + Vite 6 + TypeScript SPA with Supabase backend and PHP microservice
build_system: pnpm + Vite 6, tsc for type checking
test_framework: No frontend test framework installed; validation via tsc + vite build
verification_instructions: Run pnpm build which executes tsc -b && vite build. Must produce zero errors.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No Supabase CLI available for running migrations. PHP backend exists but no runtime needed for frontend build.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode, dark spatial glassmorphism design, use existing patterns from inventory services

key_patterns.service_layer: src/services/inventory/ pattern: types.ts for interfaces, individual modules for each domain, index.ts barrel export
key_patterns.hooks: TanStack React Query hooks in src/hooks/ with useQuery/useMutation, queryClient invalidation
key_patterns.pages: Lazy-loaded pages in src/pages/, use motion/react for animations, Card/DataTable/PageHeader components
key_patterns.database: Types in src/types/database.ts matching migration schema exactly
key_patterns.php_api: src/services/php.ts PhpApiClient class with getAuthHeaders(), request() method
key_patterns.routing: src/App.tsx with lazy imports and Route declarations
key_patterns.design_system: glassmorphism cards, 24px radius, emerald primary (#10b981), dark bg (#0a0a0a), motion animations

directory_structure: src/services/ (service layers by domain), src/hooks/ (TanStack Query hooks), src/pages/ (route pages), src/components/ (UI), src/types/ (TypeScript types), supabase/migrations/ (SQL), server/php/ (PHP backend)
